meta.author: Lemon
meta.description: Released in 2013 by the Amiga demo group Lemon, Rink A Dink: Redux is an OCS/ECS demo created for the Oldskool Demo competition at Revision 2013, where it won first place. The production is a remake of the original Rink A Dink demo and combines classic Amiga demo effects such as plasma, vector graphics, and scrolling displays with a soundtrack by Magnar and Nuke. Due to its compatibility with standard Amiga hardware and its variety of effects, it has been used extensively as a reference production during the development and testing of vAmiga.
